mil5.5.1:3.2: Vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsay' ettha bahussute ti.
mil5.5.1:3.4: Santhavāto bhayaṃ jātaṃ, niketā jāyatī rajo,
mil5.5.1:3.5: aniketam-asanthavaṃ, etaṃ ve munidassanan-ti, tena hi: Vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsay' ettha bahussute ti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.5.1:3.7: Vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsay' ettha bahussute ti, tena hi: Santhavāto bhayaṃ jātaṃ
mil5.5.1:3.9: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.5.1:4.2: Santhavāto bhayaṃ jātaṃ, niketā jāyatī rajo,
mil5.5.1:4.5: Vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsay' ettha bahussute ti.
mil5.5.1:4.8: ti, taṃ sabhāvavacanaṃ asesavacanaṃ nissesavacanaṃ nippariyāyavacanaṃ samaṇānucchavaṃ samaṇasāruppaṃ samaṇapatirūpaṃ samaṇārahaṃ samaṇagocaraṃ samaṇapaṭipadā samaṇapaṭipatti.
mil5.5.1:4.9: Yathā mahārāja āraññako migo araññe pavane caramāno nirālayo aniketo yathicchakaṃ sayati,
mil5.5.1:4.10: evam-eva kho mahārāja bhikkhunā: Santhavāto bhayaṃ jātaṃ, niketā jāyatī rajo,
mil5.5.1:5.2: Vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsay' ettha bahussute ti, taṃ dve atthavase sampassamānena Bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ,
mil5.5.1:5.4: Vihāradānaṃ nāma sabbabuddhehi vaṇṇitaṃ anumataṃ thomitaṃ pasatthaṃ, taṃ te vihāradānaṃ datvā jāti-jarā-maraṇā parimuccissantīti;
mil5.5.1:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ: vihāre vijjamāne bhikkhuniyo byattasanketā bhavissanti, sulabhaṃ dassanaṃ dassanakāmānaṃ, anikete duddassanā bhavissantīti;
mil5.5.1:6.3: Ime dve atthavase sampassamānena Bhagavatā bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.5.1:6.4: Vihāre kāraye ramme, vāsay' ettha bahussute ti; na tattha Buddhaputtena ālayo karaṇīyo nikete ti.
mil5.5.1:6.5: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
